title: ArtifactRef
description: Lightweight reference to a large output stored externally (artifacts/), returned to the lead agent instead of the raw content. See reference/multi-agent-architecture-notes.md section 4 (avoid the 'game of telephone').

createdBy.description: Agent role or id that wrote this artifact - establishes write ownership.

summary.description: One-paragraph distillation, safe to inline in a lead agent's context without fetching the full artifact.

uri.description: Storage location (e.g. file:// path for the local FS store, s3:// for a pluggable backend). Not assumed directly readable by every caller.
